ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading: Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading: Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading: Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Arabic Alphabet.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Articulation.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Articulation.

7. When practising Imitative Speaking: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Fluency.

8. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

9. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

10. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Selective Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness: Articulation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
